data.body:
VERIFY-FIRST evidence — already resolved on current origin/main (tip cf7c31bec4b6).

The exact defect in this bug — attested ref resolution opening with an UNSCOPED `git fetch --no-filter origin` that applies the clone's `+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*` refspec and pulls the unrelated oversized `tickets` branch into the code checkout — is fixed by two changes that merged after this ticket was filed:

- Gerrit 2178 / lemuroid-compliant-hoopoe (39a2-4832-e436-4850, commit 60348ef146fa 'Scope resolve_ref's opening fetch to the ref'): `resolve_ref` now scopes the opening fetch via `scoped_fetch_target(ref, remote)` — a remote-qualified ref becomes `+<name>:refs/remotes/<remote>/<name>`, a bare SHA is a targeted want — so it never falls back to the all-heads refspec. This is the primary fix for this bug's symptom.
- Gerrit 2180 / sawdusty-snotty-fossa (c6bd-b10e-74f1-407f, commit cf7c31bec4b6 'Skip resolve_ref fetch for a present full SHA'): adds `is_present_full_sha` so a locally-present immutable full SHA skips the opening fetch entirely.

AC-by-AC confirmation against current origin/main (all in worktree urubu-fix at cf7c31bec4b6):
1. Reviewing origin/main w/ a larger tickets head fetches main WITHOUT updating refs/remotes/origin/tickets or transferring tickets-only objects — proven by tests/unit/test_snapshot_targeted_fetch.py::test_resolving_remote_ref_scopes_the_fetch (asserts no unscoped origin fetch, refs/remotes/origin/tickets absent, tickets blobs still missing).
2. Moving branch/tag refreshed (test_scoped_fetch_updates_the_remote_tracking_ref); explicit reachable SHA supported (test_bare_sha_resolution_scopes_to_the_object); fail-closed on unresolvable ref (test_unresolvable_ref_still_fails_closed, SnapshotRefError).
3. blobless=False materializes selected commit's blobs in one bounded path without promisor latch — resolve_ref/materialize pass blobless=False; covered by test_snapshot_blobless_747f.py and test_snapshot_present_sha_no_fetch.py.
4. Common-Git-directory coordination + bounded recovery preserved: fetch_origin still serializes on fetch_lock_for + interprocess_lock(lock_path) (the snapshot fetch lock, NOT the ticket write lock); untouched by 2178/2180.
5. Deterministic local-repo test with an oversized unrelated branch proving selected-ref transfer/ref-update isolation: tests/unit/test_snapshot_targeted_fetch.py (blob:none clone, _TICKETS_FILE_COUNT=60 unrelated branch, RED->GREEN).
6. Existing snapshot suite green: ran test_snapshot_targeted_fetch, test_snapshot_present_sha_no_fetch, test_snapshot_blobless_747f, test_repo_snapshot, test_snapshot_docs — 37 passed.
7. Documentation: docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md now has a 'Fetch scope — what a resolution actually transfers' section explaining selected-ref scope AND its distinction from the separate tickets pin / tracker synchronization.

No residual delta remains. This bug is a duplicate of lemuroid-compliant-hoopoe (which fixed the exact symptom), with sawdusty-snotty-fossa completing the present-SHA/docs coverage. Linking duplicates->hoopoe and relates_to->fossa, closing --class=duplicate.
